_comment: Copy this to .claude/settings.json in your research project to enable framework hooks. Skills installed under .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md are auto-discovered by Claude Code. Stop blocks when a plan is marked .completed but not yet archived; UserPromptSubmit surfaces relevant learnings; PreCompact reminds to refresh the active plan handoff and capture session learnings. Evidence invariants are checked by .claude/hooks/lint-research.sh, run manually or from CI rather than on every Stop.
